reference_basis.citation: Zhang, Z. and Paulino, G.H. (2005), Cohesive zone modeling of dynamic failure in homogeneous and functionally graded materials, International Journal of Plasticity 21, 1195-1254, doi:10.1016/j.ijplas.2004.06.009.

reference_basis.note: This is a peer-reviewed implementation/formulation reference, not the original first proposal.
